text:
jen: Heads up — rolling deploy v2026.3 to eu-west at 14:00 UTC. Small runtime + scheduler change. Preflight smokewatch at +5m and +15m. Please monitor SLO panels and watch for 429/5xx spikes. @oncall? :eyes:

deploy-bot: Started rollout r-2026-03-589 -> eu-west, batch 1/5. Will auto-ramp per policy unless paused.

sam: Thanks. I'll watch p95, p50 and 5xx dashboards. Quick link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/ops/slo?orgId=1&var-region=eu-west

kai: I'll set an initial traffic pin. plan: 10% for 10m, then 50% if stable. cmd: `/deploy pin r-2026-03-589 10% 10m` :ok_hand:

ops-bot: Preflight smokewatch scheduled. Checks: latency_p95, error_rate_5xx(1m), request_rate. Alert thresholds: 5xx > 0.8% OR p95 > baseline * 1.3 will fire.

alex: Running synthetic prompt suite against the canary now, will post short pass/fail. :mag:

maria: Seeing an early 10% bump in 429s concentrated on embed-service routes — small sample but noticeable. Posting a quick snapshot:```
14:05:12 embed-service 429s: +12 (baseline 3)
14:05:18 api-gateway 5xx: 0
14:05:45 kv-cache latency p95: +40ms
```

sam: Recommend hold and consider rollback if 429s persist >2m on embed routes. Suggest pin to stable for embed-route. @jen? :warning:

jen: Agreed. Hold ramp at 10% and pause further rollout. If we don't see improvement by 14:09 UTC, we'll roll back.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-589 paused by users. Current traffic: 10%. Action: investigation required.

alex: Synthetic suite shows tokenization errors on a small subset of long prompts (3 failures). Log snippet: `TokenizeError: invalid sequence` — likely unrelated but worth flagging.

maria: ops-alert triggered: `embed-429-exceed`. I'm initiating a quick route pin away from canary for embed-service.

sam: Can we route embed-service traffic to stable-v2026.2? Command: `/route pin embed-service stable-v2026.2 5m`

kai: Pinned embed-service -> stable-v2026.2 for 5m. Command output: OK. :white_check_mark:

jen: Thanks. Capture this in the release notes: "paused due to embed 429 spike; pinned embed routes to stable; investigating scheduler interaction." Marking release status: paused - awaiting fix.

deploy-bot: Rollout r-2026-03-589 status: PAUSED_BY_USERS. Notifying release channel.

ops-bot: Summary: pause triggered by embed 429 spike during smokewatch at 10% traffic. Recommended next steps: revert embed scheduler patch, reproduce in staging, re-run smokewatch with synthetic suite.

sam: I'll draft a short rollback rationale and post to #eng-releases. Will also attach the smokewatch snapshot and quick grafana links.

jen: Good catch everyone. We'll reconvene in 15m unless the embed team has a quick fix. :thumbsup:
